sampling_frame: Frozen cumulative300 probability sample from 1,500 released tasks; not a benchmark census.
blindness: Both providers saw actual released figures, question and all options; neither saw gold, the other provider output, native verifier outcome, DeepSeek answer or selection reason.
accounting: GPT reviewed all 300. Claude reviewed every one of the 96 unique high-confidence GPT flags (28 first100, 68 next200). Unflagged, disagreements, ambiguity and errors count as non-errors in denominator300.

cluster_inference.group_key: released paper/task prefix before question index

inference: The precommitted two-look Wilson and paper-group cluster lower bounds for FP are both strictly above 15%; MATCHA definitively fails the verifier FP gate. FN remains unresolved and is not needed for the overall failure.
accuracy_stop: The frozen DeepSeek expansion stopped only after the FP failure became definitive. All 161 completed additional attempts are retained; 39 unrun tasks are not replaced or rerun. The n100 primary accuracy remains 70/100 at the excluded boundary with simultaneous intervals crossing70%, and no incomplete-expansion point estimate is used as a qualification result.
raw_policy: Detailed provider outputs remain outside git.
